state.product: pi-vida: personal per-language agent harness (vidas: rust, elixir, ruby, python). Direction set by owner 2026-09-22: personal daily driver, but the skills/packs layer is meant to be shared with others. Harness install UX for strangers is out of scope for now.

owner_usage_last_30_days.host_projection: daily; kilo about 70 percent, cline about 30 percent, claude never
owner_usage_last_30_days.capabilities_and_hygiene: daily: graphify, codegraph, serena overlays, doctor, boot-config wizard

state.evidence_quality: Owner recall from the primary machine (a different computer); this machine's shell history is void as evidence.

features.solo_launch: pi-vida <vida> execs pi with the INV-skills argv: damage-control gate extension, --no-skills, then allowlisted --skill paths. The core path everything else builds on.
features.modes_chain_team_fusion: chain runs plan-build-review as child sessions; team is dispatcher-only with dispatch_agent to named specialists; fusion is a vendored multi-model stack of 2-5 models in one session.
features.host_projection_cline_kilo: --host cline|kilo: Rust launcher installs and projects vida skills into host dirs (~/.agents/skills, ~/.kilo/skills), then execs the host or prints a start hint.
features.host_projection_claude: --host claude: same projection into ~/.claude/skills. Owner reports never using claude.
features.herdr_integration: INV-herdr: inside HERDR_ENV, team mode splits one terminal pane per member via herdr agent start; dispatch via herdr agent prompt/read, only for launcher-started members.
features.terminal_ux: Interactive gum host/vida/mode menu on no-arg TTY launch, plus the solo-only status-line extension. Owner launches via hosts, so terminal-only UX is rarely exercised.

state.maintenance_context: Every shipped feature carries ongoing cost: rs-guard enforced invariants (INV-skills, INV-herdr), just smoke coverage, and docs surface in CONTEXT.md, README.md, docs/how-to.md.
